conf.description: zos-racf racinit / json: CDPz System Data Engine SMF-80 JSON feed. The SDE's own SMF-80 key names are documented only in an IBM reference this work order could not retrieve (fields[] is deliberately empty with fields_omitted explaining why), so this deserializes the JSON structurally and tags event.dataset without guessing per-field ECS targets.

conf.comment: zos-racf / racinit / json. No Elastic integration or Cribl pack exists for CDPz output, so nothing downstream re-parses this - unlike the thin pass-through blocks generated elsewhere in this project for Elastic-integration-covered formats, doing a real serde JSON extract here is the only opportunity to structure this data, not a redundant duplicate of a downstream parser. fields_omitted says the SDE's own SMF-80 field names could not be retrieved for this entry (a real IBM reference exists but was not fetchable), so per the do-not-guess rule no per-field ECS mapping is attempted - the JSON is decoded into real typed fields under their own SDE-assigned names so a verified crosswalk can be layered on later without re-parsing text. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: record the field-name-unpublished limitation and why this is a real (structural) parse, not a pass-through
deserialize the CDPz Data Streamer JSON into fields under the SDE's own (unpublished, uncrosswalked) key names
tag event.dataset with no hyphen (constraint 5); no other ECS mapping attempted per the field-name gap
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
